segment.name: Multinational
segment.systems: GlobalNet (master + local policy issuance tracking) · Fronting-partner portal + bordereaux spreadsheets · DIC/DIL analysis workbooks · Premium allocation models (Excel) · Master policy wordings (Word) · FOS/admitted compliance matrices · IPT tables
segment.operatingPattern: Master policies with DIC/DIL sitting over locally issued admitted policies from a fronting-partner network, coordinated in GlobalNet with Excel-based allocation, bordereaux and compliance matrices around it.
segment.distribution: Global broker networks (controlled master placements); local brokers appointed per country for local policy servicing
segment.placement: Master + local: one controlling master program with locally admitted policies issued through fronting partners per country
segment.reinsurance: Fronting partners reinsured back to the program carrier via facultative/quota-share cessions; cat protections on the retained global book
segment.regulatory: Per-country compliance matrix — admitted-paper-required countries, FOS in the EEA, IPT and parafiscal charges, premium tax remittance; no US SERFF for the non-admitted global master

behavior.Product Taxonomy: Program structures (master + N locals) recorded in GlobalNet with country availability, paper type and version lineage per program year
behavior.Coverages: Master manuscript wording grants worldwide cover with DIC/DIL over good-local-standard local policies; local grants follow each country's market forms
behavior.Terms: Master program limit and cat sublimits by zone govern globally; local limits and deductibles set at good-local-standard within master constraints
behavior.Rating: Cat-model AAL by country zone plus engineering-driven rates on TIV; local tariff and pool constraints (e.g. Spain Consorcio, France Cat Nat) override in-country
behavior.Pricing: Arm's-length premium allocation by country in tax-counsel-reviewed Excel models; fronting fees, IPT and parafiscal charges applied per country
behavior.Underwriting Rules: Sanctions screening on every location and counterparty; admitted-paper-required countries enforced from the compliance matrix; fronting-partner security standards
behavior.Forms: Master policy wording maintained as a Word manuscript with negotiated clause library; local policy forms issued by fronting partners on local standard
behavior.Filings: No US SERFF for the non-admitted master; per-country local compliance handled by fronting partners with premium tax remitted per the IPT tables
behavior.Lifecycle Behavior: Annual program-year cycle: pre-renewal instructions to fronting partners 120 days out, local issuance SLAs, monthly premium/claims bordereaux, master-controlled claims over thresholds

components.name: Coverages
components.expression: All-risk master with DIC/DIL over locals

items.name: All-risk property damage (master)
items.description: Worldwide all-risk direct physical loss or damage to insured property, subject to master exclusions and territory clause.
items.livesIn: Master policy wording (Word) — Section 1 insuring agreement

items.name: Business interruption (master)
items.description: Gross-profit-basis BI following insured damage, 24-month maximum indemnity period.
items.livesIn: Master policy wording — Section 2; BI values in country schedules

items.name: Difference in Conditions (DIC)
items.description: Master pays where a peril is covered by the master but excluded or absent from the local policy in the loss country.
items.livesIn: Master policy wording — DIC/DIL clause, Section 5; DIC/DIL analysis workbook

items.name: Difference in Limits (DIL)
items.description: Master tops up loss amounts exceeding local policy limits or sublimits, up to the master program limit.
items.livesIn: Master policy wording — DIC/DIL clause, Section 5

items.name: Contingent business interruption (CBI)
items.description: BI from damage at named tier-1 suppliers and customers, $25M sublimit, unnamed premises $5M.
items.livesIn: Master policy wording — CBI extension; supplier schedule appendix

items.name: Cat perils with zone sublimits
items.description: Earthquake, flood and windstorm covered with per-zone sublimits (e.g. Japan EQ $50M, Chile EQ $40M, Gulf-of-Mexico windstorm $75M).
items.livesIn: Master policy wording — cat sublimit schedule; cat zone tab in DIC/DIL workbook

items.name: Good-local-standard local coverage
items.description: Each local policy issued on the country's standard property form (e.g. German extended coverage, French multirisque) at agreed local limits.
items.livesIn: Fronting-partner portal — local policy forms; local policy tracker

items.name: Service interruption and expediting expenses
items.description: Utility service interruption (with 24h waiting period) and expediting expenses to accelerate reinstatement, each sublimited.
items.livesIn: Master policy wording — extensions schedule

components.name: Terms
components.expression: Master limit $500M; zone sublimits; local GLS terms

items.name: Master program limit $500M
items.description: Single overall program limit per occurrence applying over all locals; annual aggregate only for EQ and flood.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — program limits record; master wording limits schedule

items.name: Cat sublimits by CRESTA zone
items.description: Sublimits allocated by country/CRESTA zone from the cat-modeling output, reviewed each program year.
items.livesIn: DIC/DIL analysis workbook — cat sublimit tab; master wording schedule

items.name: Local policy limits at good-local-standard
items.description: Local limits set to satisfy local insurance requirements and typical market practice, with the master absorbing severity above.
items.livesIn: Local policy tracker — limit column; DIC/DIL gap analysis

items.name: Master deductibles vs local deductibles
items.description: Local deductibles apply within country; master DIC/DIL losses bear the master deductible ($250K PD, 72h BI waiting period).
items.livesIn: Master policy wording — deductible schedule; DIC/DIL workbook

items.name: 72-hour occurrence clause
items.description: All windstorm/EQ losses within any 72-hour period treated as one occurrence for limits and deductibles.
items.livesIn: Master policy wording — occurrence definition

items.name: BI waiting period 72 hours (utilities 24h)
items.description: BI attaches after 72 hours; the service-interruption extension carries its own 24-hour waiting period.
items.livesIn: Master policy wording — BI conditions; extensions schedule

items.name: Currency and exchange clause
items.description: Master limits in USD; local losses adjusted in local currency and converted at date-of-loss rates.
items.livesIn: Master policy wording — currency clause; allocation model FX tab

components.name: Rating
components.expression: Cat-model AAL + engineering rates by country

items.name: Cat model AAL by country zone
items.description: Modeled average annual loss per country/CRESTA zone drives the cat portion of technical premium and the sublimit structure.
items.livesIn: Cat modeling output — program run 2026; DIC/DIL workbook cat tab

items.name: Engineering rate on TIV by risk quality
items.description: Non-cat rate per mille of TIV banded by engineering grade from survey reports (highly protected risk to substandard).

items.name: BI values and indemnity-period rating
items.description: BI premium rated on declared gross-profit values and indemnity period per country schedule.
items.livesIn: Country schedules — BI values; global property rating workbook

items.name: Local tariff constraints
items.description: Where local tariffs or pools set minimum property rates (e.g. Spain Consorcio extraordinary-risks surcharge, France Cat Nat 12% property surcharge), local premium is floored accordingly.

items.name: Master general liability (occurrence)
items.description: Worldwide BI/PD and personal-and-advertising-injury liability on the master, excess-DIC over locals in local countries.
items.livesIn: Master casualty wording (Word) — insuring agreement; GlobalNet program record

items.name: Local GL policies (good-local-standard)
items.description: Local GL issued per country market form (e.g. German Betriebshaftpflicht, Japanese CGL) at agreed local limits.
items.livesIn: Fronting-partner portal — local GL policies; local policy tracker

items.name: Employers liability where compulsory
items.description: UK EL at £10M (statutory minimum £5M) and Italian RC verso prestatori d'opera issued locally where law requires.
items.livesIn: Local policy tracker — EL rows; UK ELCI certificate file

items.name: Products liability worldwide
items.description: Products and completed-operations coverage on master and locals, including US/Canada exports from all program entities.
items.livesIn: Master casualty wording — products section; local policy schedules

items.name: FOS coverage in the EEA
items.description: EEA countries without compulsory local paper served on freedom-of-services basis from the Irish carrier under one FOS policy.
items.livesIn: FOS policy record in GlobalNet; compliance matrix FOS column

items.name: DIC/DIL over local casualty policies
items.description: Master pays above local limits and where master grants exceed local coverage, per the controlled-master clause.
items.livesIn: Master casualty wording — DIC/DIL clause; DIC/DIL workbook casualty tab

items.name: Master limits $25M occurrence / $50M aggregate
items.description: Program-controlling limits on the US master, sitting over all locals and the FOS policy.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — program limits; master wording limits schedule

items.name: Local GL limits at good-local-standard
items.description: Local limits set per market practice (e.g. €10M Germany, A$20M Australia) within the master structure.
items.livesIn: Local policy tracker — limit column; DIC/DIL gap analysis

items.name: UK EL limit £10M
items.description: UK employers liability at £10M market standard, above the £5M ELCI statutory minimum.
items.livesIn: UK local policy schedule; compliance matrix UK row

items.name: Master deductible $100K per occurrence
items.description: Master retains $100K per occurrence on DIC/DIL losses; local deductibles per local schedules.
items.livesIn: Master casualty wording — deductible provision

items.name: Aggregate erosion tracking master vs locals
items.description: Local paid losses erode local aggregates only; master aggregate erodes on master-paid DIC/DIL amounts.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — aggregate tracking; claims bordereaux

items.name: Territory and jurisdiction clause
items.description: Worldwide territory; US/Canada suits covered under the master with defense-inside-limits for locals that exclude North America.
items.livesIn: Master casualty wording — territory clause

items.name: Exposure rating on turnover by country
items.description: GL rate per mille of country turnover, banded by industry class and product mix from the exposure schedules.
items.livesIn: Casualty rating workbook — exposure tabs; country turnover schedules

items.name: Payroll-based EL rating
items.description: UK/Italy EL rated on payroll at market-informed rates subject to statutory coverage requirements.
items.livesIn: Casualty rating workbook — EL tab; payroll schedules

items.name: Global experience modification
items.description: Program experience mod from five-year global loss history, large losses capped at $500K for mod purposes.
items.livesIn: Casualty rating workbook — experience tab; program loss bordereaux

items.name: ILFs for master limit
items.description: Increased limits factors applied to develop the $25M master limit premium from the working-layer base rate.
items.livesIn: Casualty rating workbook — ILF tab

items.name: US products exposure load
items.description: Debit for US/Canada product sales share per entity, reflecting US litigation severity.
items.livesIn: Casualty rating workbook — US exposure tab; sales-by-territory schedule

items.name: Local tariff/bureau constraints
items.description: Local minimum-rate or bureau-form constraints (e.g. Japanese market GL conventions) floored at local rating.
items.livesIn: Compliance matrix — casualty tariff notes; fronting partner rating confirmations

items.name: Premium allocation by country turnover
items.description: Master premium allocated across countries on turnover and exposure metrics, documented arm's-length for transfer pricing.
items.livesIn: Premium allocation model (Excel) — CMC-2025; tax counsel review memo

items.name: Fronting fees per local policy
items.description: Per-country fronting fees under the network agreement, netted from local premium cessions.
items.livesIn: Fronting network agreement — fee schedule; allocation model fee tab

items.name: IPT on local casualty premiums
items.description: IPT applied at country rates on local GL/EL premium — UK 12%, Germany 19%, Australia state stamp duties per schedule.
items.livesIn: IPT rate table — casualty rows; local invoices via fronting portal

items.name: US master premium taxation
items.description: US master premium taxed under the issuing state's admitted premium tax regime (no surplus lines — admitted US paper).
items.livesIn: US premium tax filing records; allocation model US tab

items.name: Minimum premiums per local policy
items.description: Local minimum premiums ensuring each local policy is self-supporting for local tax and regulatory purposes.
items.livesIn: Allocation model — local minima tab; fronting partner invoices

items.name: Turnover adjustment provision
items.description: Deposit premium on estimated turnover, adjusted at expiry on declared actuals per country.
items.livesIn: Master casualty wording — adjustment clause; year-end declaration workbook

items.name: OFAC/sanctions screening
items.description: All entities, countries and counterparties screened at inception, renewal and on mid-term entity adds.
items.livesIn: Sanctions screening tool — CMC program log

items.name: Admitted-paper-required countries
items.description: China and India entities require locally admitted GL — master-only coverage prohibited; enforced from the matrix before entity add.
items.livesIn: FOS/admitted compliance matrix — casualty prohibition flags

items.name: Compulsory EL verification
items.description: Countries with compulsory employers liability (UK ELCI, Italian INAIL interaction) verified for compliant local issuance before binding.
items.livesIn: Compliance matrix — EL column; UK ELCI certificate file

items.name: US punitive damages treatment
items.description: Punitive damages covered where insurable by law via the most-favorable-jurisdiction clause; referral required for US-heavy product entities.
items.livesIn: Master casualty wording — punitive clause; UW referral log

items.name: Product recall and pharma exclusion gate
items.description: Entities with pharmaceutical, medical-device or recall-prone product lines require home-office casualty referral.
items.livesIn: UW referral rules — casualty appetite guide; entity product schedules

items.name: Local claims-handling capability check
items.description: Fronting partners must demonstrate local claims handling and defense-counsel panels in each issuing country.
items.livesIn: Fronting network agreement — claims annex; partner capability reviews

components.name: Forms
components.expression: US master manuscript + local market forms

items.name: Master casualty wording CMC-2025 (manuscript)
items.description: US-issued controlled-master GL wording with DIC/DIL clause, territory and most-favorable-jurisdiction provisions.
items.livesIn: Master policy wordings library (Word) — CMC-2025 executed copy

items.name: Local GL forms via fronting partners
items.description: Country market forms — German AHB-based Betriebshaftpflicht, French RC générale, Japanese CGL — issued locally.
items.livesIn: Fronting-partner portal — local form copies

items.name: UK ELCI certificate
items.description: Employers' Liability Compulsory Insurance certificate issued with the UK local policy and available for statutory display.
items.livesIn: UK local policy file — ELCI certificate; fronting partner records

items.name: FOS policy wording (Irish carrier)
items.description: Single freedom-of-services GL wording covering FOS-eligible EEA countries with country schedules.
items.livesIn: Master policy wordings library — FOS policy; FOS notification register

items.name: LMA3100 — Sanction Limitation and Exclusion Clause
items.description: Sanctions clause on master, FOS policy and locals where permitted.
items.livesIn: Master casualty wording — clauses section; local wording checklists

items.name: Cross-suits and insured-vs-insured provisions
items.description: Cross-liability clause enabling claims between program entities, standard for multi-entity programs.
items.livesIn: Master casualty wording — conditions section

components.name: Filings
components.expression: US admitted master + per-country local compliance

items.name: US master on admitted paper
items.description: Master issued on US admitted commercial casualty paper under the carrier's filed large-account rating plan in the issuing state.
items.livesIn: US filing record — issuing state; PAS/GlobalNet paper flag

items.name: Local regulatory compliance matrix (casualty)
items.description: Per-country GL/EL licensing, compulsory coverage and policy-language requirements for the 14 locals.
items.livesIn: FOS/admitted compliance matrix — casualty tab

items.name: UK ELCI statutory compliance
items.description: UK EL issued by an authorised insurer at or above £5M with certificate retention per ELCI regulations.
items.livesIn: Compliance matrix — UK row; ELCI certificate file

items.name: EEA FOS notifications (casualty)
items.description: FOS passporting current for the Irish-carrier GL policy across served EEA countries.
items.livesIn: FOS notification register — casualty entries

items.name: Premium tax remittance per country
items.description: IPT/stamp duties remitted by fronting partners or the FOS carrier with evidence retained per country.
items.livesIn: IPT remittance tracker — casualty program

items.name: Pre-renewal instructions at 120 days
items.description: Renewal instructions (exposure updates, limits, invoicing) to all fronting partners 120 days before the 06/01 inception.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — renewal instruction workflow CMC

items.name: Local policy issuance SLAs
items.description: Local GL/EL policies issued within 30 days of inception with SLA tracking and escalation.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — local policy tracker SLA dashboard

items.name: Monthly premium and claims bordereaux
items.description: Fronting partners report local premiums, fees, taxes and claims monthly via the portal spreadsheets.
items.livesIn: Fronting-partner portal — bordereaux spreadsheets

items.name: Turnover audit at expiry
items.description: Declared actual turnover/payroll collected per country at year end; adjustment premium invoiced through locals and master.
items.livesIn: Year-end declaration workbook; GlobalNet adjustment records

items.name: Master claims control over $250K
items.description: Local claims above $250K (or any US suit) move to master claims control with coordinated defense strategy.
items.livesIn: Master casualty wording — claims control clause; claims system CMC files

items.name: Mid-term entity additions
items.description: Acquisitions added by endorsement after sanctions/compliance screening, with local policy issuance where the country requires.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — entity add workflow; compliance matrix check log

products.name: Marine Cargo Open Cover
products.description: Worldwide open cover for the insured's global goods in transit on ICC(A) terms with war and strikes, declaration-based with monthly bordereaux and adjustment against minimum-and-deposit premium.

components.name: Product Taxonomy
components.expression: Open cover with declarations and certificates

items.name: Open cover structure MCO-2025
items.description: Annual worldwide open cover under which individual shipments are automatically held covered and declared monthly.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — program record MCO-2025; open cover wording

items.name: Commodity and route taxonomy
items.description: Declared commodity classes (electronics, industrial machinery, spare parts) mapped to route groups and conveyance types for rating.
items.livesIn: Cargo rating schedule — commodity/route matrix; declaration template

items.name: Certificate issuance framework
items.description: Per-shipment insurance certificates issued against the open cover for consignees, banks and letters of credit.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — certificate module; certificate register

items.name: Annual policy dating with cancellation notices
items.description: 12-month open cover from 03/2025; war/strikes cover cancellable on short market notice independent of the marine term.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — program dates; war cover notice provisions

items.name: Storage location schedule
items.description: Named warehouses and consolidation points with per-location accumulation limits appended to the cover.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — location schedule; accumulation workbook

items.name: Institute Cargo Clauses (A) — CL382 1/1/09
items.description: All-risks cover for loss or damage to insured cargo, the broadest Institute cargo grant.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — CL382 incorporation; clauses annex

items.name: Institute War Clauses (Cargo) — CL385
items.description: War-perils cover for cargo afloat, subject to the waterborne limitation and JWC area conditions.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — CL385; war rating schedule

items.name: Institute Strikes Clauses (Cargo) — CL386
items.description: Loss or damage caused by strikers, locked-out workmen and persons taking part in labour disturbances or civil commotions.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — CL386

items.name: Warehouse-to-warehouse transit (Transit Clause 8)
items.description: Cover attaches from the warehouse of origin and continues in ordinary course of transit to final destination warehouse.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — CL382 Transit Clause; location schedule

items.name: General average and salvage
items.description: GA and salvage contributions adjusted per York-Antwerp Rules covered under the ICC(A) grant.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — GA clause; claims adjustment files

items.name: Reefer breakdown extension
items.description: Deterioration of temperature-controlled cargo from reefer machinery breakdown exceeding 24 consecutive hours.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — reefer extension; commodity schedule reefer rows

items.name: Debris removal and forwarding charges
items.description: Sublimited extensions for debris removal after insured loss and extra forwarding costs to destination.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — extensions annex

items.name: Per-conveyance limit $10M
items.description: Maximum insured value any one vessel, aircraft or road/rail conveyance.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — limits schedule; GlobalNet program limits

items.name: Per-location storage limit $15M
items.description: Maximum accumulation at any named warehouse or consolidation point outside ordinary transit.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — location schedule; accumulation workbook

items.name: Accumulation clause
items.description: Unintended accumulations above limits held covered up to 200% for 30 days subject to prompt declaration and additional premium.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — accumulation clause

items.name: Deductibles per shipment class
items.description: Nil deductible on general cargo; $25K on used machinery; $10K plus 24-hour clause on reefer claims.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — deductible schedule; commodity matrix

items.name: Valuation CIF + 10%
items.description: Insured value fixed at cost, insurance and freight plus 10% anticipated profit unless otherwise declared.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — valuation clause; declaration template

items.name: Premium payment warranty
items.description: Declared premiums payable within 60 days of monthly bordereau; cover voidable ab initio for the affected declarations on default.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — premium warranty; bordereaux reconciliation

items.name: Base rate per $100 insured value
items.description: Commodity-class base rates (e.g. 0.045 electronics containerized, 0.110 used machinery breakbulk) per $100 of declared value.
items.livesIn: Cargo rating schedule — commodity rate matrix

items.name: Route group modifiers
items.description: Rate modifiers by trade lane (transpacific, intra-EU, Latin America inland) reflecting theft, handling and infrastructure risk.
items.livesIn: Cargo rating schedule — route group tab

items.name: Conveyance factors
items.description: FCL container base, LCL surcharge, breakbulk and airfreight factors applied per declaration line.
items.livesIn: Cargo rating schedule — conveyance factor tab

items.name: War risk rates by JWC area
items.description: War premium at market scale rates for Joint War Committee listed areas, updated as JWC circulars amend the list.
items.livesIn: War rating schedule; JWC circular tracker

items.name: Vessel age and classification adjustments
items.description: Overage and non-IACS-classed vessel surcharges per the Institute Classification Clause CL354 basis.
items.livesIn: Cargo rating schedule — vessel adjustment tab; CL354 in clauses annex

items.name: Annual volume discount
items.description: Turnover-banded discount on base rates against declared annual sendings, trued at adjustment.
items.livesIn: Cargo rating schedule — volume band tab; M&D adjustment workbook

components.name: Pricing
components.expression: M&D with adjustment; war AP; tax by country

items.name: Minimum and deposit premium
items.description: Annual M&D at 85% of estimated premium from projected sendings, payable quarterly in advance.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — M&D premium record; M&D adjustment workbook

items.name: Adjustment on declared values at expiry
items.description: Actual declared sendings rated at expiry; premium above deposit collected, no return below the minimum.
items.livesIn: M&D adjustment workbook; declaration bordereaux archive

items.name: War additional premiums (JWC areas)
items.description: Voyage-specific war APs for transits touching JWC listed areas, quoted at current market scale before sailing.
items.livesIn: War rating schedule; AP quotation log in GlobalNet

items.name: UK IPT exemption for international transit
items.description: Premium for international marine transit cargo exempt from UK IPT; domestic UK-only legs assessed where applicable.
items.livesIn: IPT rate table — marine exemption rows; tax counsel note

items.name: Local premium taxes on domestic legs
items.description: Country-specific taxes on purely domestic transits (e.g. Indian GST on local cargo premium) applied per the tax table.
items.livesIn: IPT/parafiscal table — marine rows; local invoicing records

items.name: Brokerage on declared premium
items.description: Placing brokerage as a percentage of gross declared premium, reconciled on each monthly bordereau.
items.livesIn: Bordereaux reconciliation — brokerage column; broker agreement

items.name: Named-storm accumulation referral
items.description: Projected port or warehouse accumulations above $10M in named-storm season windows (US Gulf/East Coast, Philippines) refer to marine management.
items.livesIn: Accumulation workbook — storm season tab; marine referral log

items.name: JWC listed-area transit referral
items.description: Transits through Joint War Committee listed areas (e.g. Red Sea/Gulf of Aden) require referral and war AP confirmation before sailing.
items.livesIn: JWC circular tracker; marine referral log

items.name: Vessel eligibility — CL354 basis
items.description: Carrying vessels must be IACS-classed and under 25 years (liners under 30) or incur surcharge/referral per the Classification Clause.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — CL354; vessel vetting checks

items.name: High-theft commodity controls
items.description: Electronics and branded consumer goods require secured/tracked containers and carry a $5M per-conveyance sublimit.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — commodity sublimits; security warranty annex

items.name: Sanctions screening on parties and routes
items.description: Shippers, consignees, vessels and routings screened against sanctions lists; LMA3100 applies to all certificates.
items.livesIn: Sanctions screening tool — marine log; LMA3100 in clauses annex

items.name: Survey requirement for high-value shipments
items.description: Pre-shipment survey and approved packing required for single declarations above $5M insured value.
items.livesIn: Marine survey panel list; declaration validation rules in GlobalNet

items.name: MAR 91 policy form
items.description: London-market marine policy jacket to which the Institute clauses and schedule attach.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — policy jacket; wordings library

items.name: CL382 — Institute Cargo Clauses (A) 1/1/09
items.description: All-risks cargo clause set, the primary coverage document.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — clauses annex

items.name: CL385 / CL386 — Institute War and Strikes Clauses (Cargo)
items.description: War and strikes clause sets attaching alongside ICC(A).
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — clauses annex

items.name: CL354 — Institute Classification Clause
items.description: Vessel classification and age scale governing eligible tonnage and overage APs.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — clauses annex

items.name: LMA3100 — Sanction Limitation and Exclusion Clause
items.description: Sanctions clause on the cover and every certificate issued under it.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — clauses annex; certificate template

items.name: JC2010/014 — Cargo Termination of Transit Clause (Terrorism)
items.description: Joint Cargo Committee clause governing termination of terrorism cover when transit is interrupted.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — clauses annex

items.name: Certificate of insurance template
items.description: Negotiable certificate template evidencing cover per shipment for banks and consignees under documentary credits.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — certificate module template; certificate register

components.name: Filings
components.expression: Ocean marine largely filing-exempt; local rules

items.name: US ocean marine filing exemption
items.description: Ocean marine cargo is exempt from US state form/rate filing in nearly all states — no SERFF filings for the open cover.
items.livesIn: US compliance memo — marine exemption; program file

items.name: Admitted marine requirements — India
items.description: Import consignments into India insured locally per Indian marine insurance requirements; cover coordinated to avoid non-admitted conflict.
items.livesIn: Compliance matrix — India marine row; local placement notes

items.name: Admitted marine requirements — Brazil
items.description: Brazilian import cargo insured through locally licensed markets where required; open cover responds DIC where lawful.
items.livesIn: Compliance matrix — Brazil marine row

items.name: Premium tax treatment by country
items.description: Marine transit exemptions and domestic-leg taxes documented per country with remittance where due.
items.livesIn: IPT/parafiscal table — marine rows; remittance tracker

items.name: War cover notice compliance
items.description: Seven-day (48-hour for selected areas) notice-of-cancellation provisions for war cover tracked against JWC market actions.
items.livesIn: War cover notice log; JWC circular tracker

items.name: Monthly declaration bordereaux
items.description: Insured declares all sendings monthly on the bordereau template — values, commodities, routes, conveyances — rated line by line.
items.livesIn: Declaration bordereaux spreadsheets — monthly uploads; GlobalNet ingestion

items.name: Per-shipment certificate issuance
items.description: Certificates issued on request against declared shipments, referencing the open cover and clauses.
items.livesIn: GlobalNet — certificate module; certificate register

items.name: Held-covered mechanics
items.description: Shipments outside declared terms (route deviation, overage vessel) held covered at premium to be agreed subject to prompt notice.
items.livesIn: Open cover wording — held covered clause; AP quotation log

items.name: War AP quotation before sailing
items.description: JWC-area transits priced and confirmed pre-sailing; unquoted listed-area transits are not automatically covered.
items.livesIn: AP quotation log; war rating schedule

items.name: Annual adjustment against M&D
items.description: Declared premium reconciled to deposit at expiry with adjustment invoice, subject to the minimum premium.
items.livesIn: M&D adjustment workbook; GlobalNet adjustment record

items.name: Claims documentation and survey
items.description: Claims supported by certificate, commercial invoice, B/L and survey report; surveyors appointed from the panel at destination.
items.livesIn: Claims system — marine files; marine survey panel list

items.name: War cover cancellation handling
items.description: On JWC notice events, war cover re-rated or cancelled per notice provisions with in-transit shipments run off.
items.livesIn: War cover notice log; open cover notice provisions
